method_summary: This selector increases the quality candidate pool from k*15 to k*20 and uses a round-dependent diversity weight (alpha=3.0 in early rounds 1–9, alpha=2.0 in later rounds 10–39) in the bipartite matching cost function. The higher early-round alpha prioritizes broader feature-space coverage when the model is less reliable, while the lower late-round alpha shifts focus back toward uncertain, high-information pairs as training progresses.
